mapper.insert: insert into sys_security_session_outbox (event_id, event_type, user_id, reason_code, status, attempts, available_at, created_at) values (#{eventId}, 'INVALIDATE_USER_SESSIONS', #{userId}, #{reasonCode}, 'PENDING', 0, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sys_security_session_outbox set status = 'DONE', processed_at = now(), lock_owner = null, locked_at = null, last_error_code = null where event_id = #{eventId} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

update sys_security_session_outbox set status = 'FAILED''PENDING', attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, lock_owner = null, locked_at = null where event_id = #{eventId} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

update sys_security_session_outbox set status = 'PENDING', lock_owner = null, locked_at = null, next_attempt_at = now(), last_error_code = 'STALE_CLAIM_RECOVERED' where status = 'PROCESSING' and locked_at < #{staleBefore}

update sys_security_session_outbox set status = 'PROCESSING', lock_owner = #{lockOwner}, locked_at = now() where status = 'PENDING' and available_at <= now() and (next_attempt_at is null or next_attempt_at <= now()) order by outbox_id limit #{limit}
mapper.select: select outbox_id, event_id, event_type, user_id, reason_code, status, attempts, available_at, next_attempt_at, lock_owner, locked_at, last_error_code, created_at, processed_at from sys_security_session_outbox where status = 'PROCESSING' and lock_owner = #{lockOwner} order by outbox_id
